provenance: Official digital artwork of Maryknoll Cadet Squadron (PCR-HI-030), published by Hawaii Wing (hiwg.cap.gov), heraldry page (page https://hiwg.cap.gov/about/heraldry-of-our-units; file address https://hiwg.cap.gov/media/cms/SQD_Templates_3EBF7FA793B28.png and on the unit's heraldry page https://hiwg.cap.gov/about/heraldry-of-our-units/maryknoll-heraldry-hi030/ (Maryknoll Cadet Squadron, PCR-HI-030)); fetched 2026-11-11 and kept unchanged in assets/refs/patches-official/pcr_hi_030/. Shipped as given: the PNG; reduced in size from 6487 x 7259 to 1072 x 1200 px (area average, alpha premultiplied; the long edge is held to 1200 px as the other digital patches are); no redrawing, no tracing, no colour change. Charter: the page lists it under Maryknoll Cadet Squadron, PCR-HI-030, as does the unit's own heraldry page; the emblem's banner reads MARYKNOLL CADET SQUADRON; PCR-HI-030 is Maryknoll Cadet Squadron in the builder's unit list.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the size, held to 1200 px on the long edge.
